notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Beasts![/b]

We have a lot of work to do and a lot to cover for all of our games, so let's get to it, shall we?

But first, we would like to thank those who wishlisted our games on Steam! We are very happy that you are interested in our ideas and work, and we promise to deliver the best gaming experience we can!

So, let's get to business, guys and gals!

[h2]Demolition system[/h2]

Let's admit it, it's a cool idea to wreck something up, especially when you're a gangsta! But let's keep those ideas in a virtual world, so we are going to talk about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41156161/5241fe6602b9b93e15a13a8133e6958100b11186.png[/img]

We are working on a system that will let players destroy cars, part by part! But there is an important note here. Let's not forget about some realism. To destroy a wheel, well, you need something sharp like a knife! Or you can simply shoot it with your guns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41156161/99b9bc836bb973a36f3cd88a525036192a803026.jpg[/img]

Using weapons like guns will leave holes and do significant damage to the car. Want to make some dents? You can use for example - a bat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41156161/af20e178a501c5a8cefc1cd997c0c7a950f5eb1e.png[/img]

This and many more features to the demolition system is a work in progress. Experience like this needs to be perfect in a game like this!

For now that's everything. Be safe and cautious in a gangsta world, peace out, Beasts!
